description: Photographer will be able to take photograph of persons, places, or other subjects, using various kinds of photographic equipment measuring day light using exposing meter or arranging artificial lighting and holding or placing camera at desired angle and distance from subject to be photographed and focusing lens and adjusting lens opening and exposure time.

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Identify and use Lenses following safety precautions.
Apply lighting techniques to capture quality photographs.
Use lighting and digital tools to capture, edit, and print images.
Apply multimedia and photo editing workflows to create and share images.
Demonstrate four Key Skills of a Successful Photographer.
Use video equipment and apply basic video and audio recording principles.
Apply specific technique of photography viz., time lapse, hyper lapse, high sync flash photography, arial photography and stop motion photography.
Apply Principles of Light, demonstrating the quality and types of lights.
Creating a photo story on a theme/idea/concept and apply the necessity of planning on field photography.
Demonstrate application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in photography.
On the Job Training (OJT) (150 Hours for 1 year trades)
